features.name: portal hub layout
features.notes: Separate experiences arranged around a central onward-routing space
features.quote: Portal Hub: A layout whose purpose is to send visitors onward to separate experiences.

features.name: hub portal gates
features.notes: Physical identifiable portals at logical layout endpoints
features.quote: Hub Portal Gate: Physical, clearly identifiable portal structures at logical endpoints of the layout.

features.name: hero focal structure
features.notes: Large composed landmark framed from route vantage points
features.quote: Hero Focal Build: Large, deliberately composed focal structures positioned to be framed from specific vantage points along the route.

features.name: enterable interior buildings
features.notes: Buildings visibly designed with accessible entrances
features.quote: Enterable Interior: Buildings players actually go inside rather than interact with from the street.

features.name: built up settlement
features.notes: Hamlet town or dense city block density rather than isolated buildings
features.quote: Settlement: Built-up ground at a stated density — a hamlet, a town, or a dense city block grid.

features.name: water body
features.notes: Lake river sea or pool incorporated as a real map feature
features.quote: Water Body: Standing or flowing water as a real feature of the map — a lake, river, sea, or pool.

features.name: terrain relief
features.notes: Hills mountains cliffs valley or canyon shaping the ground
features.quote: Terrain Relief: Natural landform shaping the ground: hills, mountains, cliffs, a valley, or a canyon.

features.name: connected hub routes
features.notes: Legible paths or roads connecting focal build settlement and portals
features.quote: keep the whole layout legible in one view

features.name: filming location environments
features.notes: Visible map areas can evoke city school castle beach or forest settings
features.quote: built-in maps such as cities, schools, castles, beaches, and forests

features.name: creative video props
features.notes: Trees plants rocks ocean items pirate props furniture or visual effects
features.quote: trees, sharks, ocean items, plants, rocks, pirate props, furniture, and visual effects
